name: TX-11
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a +17 Republican partisan lean
Incumbent Pfluger has a massive financial advantage ($2.9M cash vs $47K)
No polling and no expert ratings; markets price a Republican win at ~96%
model.rationale: The district's +17 Republican lean, Pfluger's incumbency, and his overwhelming fundraising edge leave Reynolds with no visible path; prediction markets agree at roughly 96% Republican. With no polls or ratings suggesting movement, the forecast stays firmly in Safe R territory.
model.watch: A late surge of Democratic outside spending or a scandal involving Pfluger would be the only realistic way this race moves toward competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-11 is a deeply Republican West Texas seat, and incumbent August Pfluger is running for reelection after easily securing renomination. The district's partisan lean of about +17 Republican makes any Democratic takeover a heavy lift under normal conditions.

Claire Reynolds has raised under $100,000 and has less than $50,000 on hand, while Pfluger holds $2.9 million in cash after raising over $3 million, with outside groups supporting him and none opposing. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets price a Republican win at roughly 96%. The forecast expects Pfluger to win by a wide, roughly eighteen-point margin.
